notes: Fitted only on the earned conjunction of two real terminal actions after joint histories. Six-item cold probes are from one pre-probe state, not six sequential remunerated actions. The separate reward/ panels execute both terminal actions continuously and withhold their taste as in training. One pair of questions (one per domain) and one of its two orders are sampled per independent geometry, then held fixed for all 64 laws. All world statistics keep the full 64 private assignments crossed within geometry. The hardest subset has two homogeneous triangle signs, two opposing context assignments and two feeder signs, giving eight of the 64 assignments.
